outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured microscopy images (not a plot of averaged data), so the individual-data-points requirement does not apply.

The main graphs in panel B plot the raw intensity measurements from a single experiment (acceptable, as these are already individual points, not averages). However, the insets explicitly show 'average early time points responses' across euchromatin and heterochromatin measurements, displayed only as mean data points with error bars. No individual replicate/measurement points underlying these averages are shown, so the variability and number of underlying data points cannot be assessed.
